result: Added a source-agnostic file membership-index builder using bounded external sorting and atomic directory publication, with source SHA256 and comparison protocol identities bound into metadata. Exact fingerprint lookup, composition/site-count near-duplicate prefiltering, prototype indexing, duplicate record-ID rejection, and fail-closed partial-build handling are implemented without adding a persistent database service. Frozen sAlex source metadata while keeping archive byte identity unresolved; production indices and exposure-audit execution remain unauthorized.
